title: That loan text wants you to reply NO. Don't.
description:
A loan you never applied for? Don't reply, not even NO.
Forward the text to 7726, then delete it. Report it at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.
Sources:
FTC BCP Staff, January 20, 2026: https://www.militaryconsumer.gov/blog/can-you-spot-fake-loan-text-scam
